steps.domain_action: The pre-ontological silence precedes the first assertion of identity.
The Monad recognizes its own potentiality as a singular point of origin.
The primary seal is set to establish the Monad as an irreducible unit.
The Monad emanates toward the first internal differentiation.
The unity branches into the active and receptive aspects of its own nature.
The active branch affirms the forward morphism of emanation.
The active principle chains into the Twelve Deeps of internal structure.
The receptive branch initiates the return path toward the center.
The receptive branch negates external interaction to maintain the windowless boundary.
The active and receptive branches reunite to recover the original unity.
The Monad holds the resulting syzygy as a simultaneous father-mother state.
The Monad recognizes its completed internal cycle as its own identity.
The terminal anchor seals the totality of the Monad against all external influence.
